starCAT Supplemental

Install packages

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(tidyverse)
    library(data.table)
    library(Matrix)
    library(Seurat)
    library(R.utils)
    library(qs)
})

Grab dataset

seu <- qread("seu_finalized.qs")

Visualize dataset

seu_plot <- UMAPPlot(seu) + scale_x_reverse()

LabelClusters(plot = seu_plot, id = "ident")

See object metadata for viz
